newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Morococha announces stock split.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Morococha announces stock split.

text.p: Peru's polymetal miner Morococha has decided to carry out a stock split to issue an extra 0.1778 share for every share currently in circulation, the Lima Stock Exchange said Monday.

Morococha will make the increase in its stock liquidity by transferring 5.101 million soles ($1.98 milllion) in capital resulting from accumulated profits and a recent revaluation of its assets, the stock exchange said in its daily report.
The blue-chip miner will also add a further 10.203 million soles in capital from the profits and asset revaluation to its net worth, according to the report.
Morococha has not announced a register nor distribution date for the share split.
